sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching out to someone who isn't there doesn't crash your world — it just quietly returns nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type indicates a function that can never successfully return — it must throw or loop forever
sketches.resonance: A promise that, by its very type signature, can never be kept.

sketches.mechanism: method_missing is called when an object receives a message it doesn't understand, allowing it to respond to anything
sketches.resonance: Even when you say something no one was prepared to hear, there is still a response — the listening itself is built in.
sketches.draft:
class Listener
  def method_missing(whatever, *_)
    self
  end
end

Listener.new.please.stay.i.need.you
